name: Upper Hutt City Council
story: From February 2003, XPLORER gave the public online access to property information that had previously been requested in paper packets. The browser service brought property and rating details, values and aerial photographs together; a government case recorded about 26,000 monthly map downloads and fewer in-person property enquiries. A 2013 upgrade added mobile HTML5 access to property, underground-service and district-planning information.
